title: $\beta$-Na$_{2}$U$_{2}$O$_{7}$ Structure
comments:
(IJdo, 2015) found Na$_{2}$U$_{2}$O$_{7}$ in two forms: \begin{itemize} \item The low temperature \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B7C2_mP44_14_ace_7e_2e-001}{$\alpha$-Na$_{2}$U$_{2}$O$_{7}$}, and \item The high-temperature \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B7C2_mC44_12_abh_3i2j_ei-001}{$\beta$-Na$_{2}$U$_{2}$O$_{7}$} phase (this structure). \end{itemize} ~ \vspace{-.25in} 
 The data for $\alpha$-Na$_{2}$U$_{2}$O$_{7}$ was taken at 293K, and the data for $\beta$-Na$_{2}$U$_{2}$O$_{7}$ was taken at 773K.  The exact transition temperature was not determined.
